summary: Tested AnyDesk Remote Sessions new features: Block/Unblock endpoints, Disconnect command, Watcher-commands polling, Unread-count badge, Blocked/Unmapped connection alerts. All 13 backend tests pass. Frontend verified: Sessions/Alerts tabs, Block/Unblock buttons, Disconnect buttons, Block reminder modal, and Admin header Monitor icon badge all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Block endpoint correctly returns reminder message about AnyDesk Settings → Security → Access Control List
Watcher-commands endpoint returns both pending commands and blocked_ids list for efficient polling
Blocked connection alert auto-queues disconnect command for immediate response
Unmapped connection alert has 1-hour dedup to prevent notification spam
Admin header Monitor icon shows red badge with alert count (24h) - green if only active sessions

context_for_next_testing_agent: AnyDesk Block/Disconnect features fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/remote-sessions/block (returns reminder message), DELETE /api/remote-sessions/block/{anydesk_id}, GET /api/remote-sessions/blocklist, POST /api/remote-sessions/disconnect, GET /api/remote-sessions/watcher-commands (watcher auth), POST /api/remote-sessions/watcher-commands/ack (query params: command_id, success), GET /api/remote-sessions/unread-count. Frontend data-testid attributes: block-btn-{anydesk_id}, unblock-btn-{anydesk_id}, disconnect-btn-{session_id}, block-reminder-modal, block-reminder-dismiss, tab-sessions, tab-alerts, alert-item-{index}. Admin header shows 'Remote Sessions' link with red badge for alert count.
